_howto: Settings for a boss's Top counters. Key each boss by its page name (collections/<slug>.html, e.g. mega-gardevoir). 'counters' are suggested attackers and 'catchTanks' suggested catch tanks; each needs a name, and can have role (main / support / exec, attackers only), fm, cm (two charge moves as "A, B"), weather (a weather it needs, e.g. "Cloudy") and a note. They fill in when the archive has fewer than 6 attackers or 4 catch tanks; add "always": true to show them anyway. 'order' sets the order of a role's row: {"main": [...], "support": [...], "exec": [...], "ct": [...]} - the Pokemon you list come first, as written, and the rest follow (Main DPS by their lowest star rating, the other roles by runs). Names as on the site, e.g. "Shadow Mewtwo", "Psycho Cut".
